attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 502500)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Ace_Combat_7:_Skies_Unknown
Fandom (acecombat.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://acecombat.fandom.com/wiki/Ace_Combat_7:_Skies_Unknown
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has "Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown" at completion stage 0; only its Controls and Achievements and trophies subpages are written (Gameplay and Walkthrough are linked but missing), so nothing was used. acecombat.fandom.com answers the API under "Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown" with about 212 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "GOJUN" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 502500. 22 of 49 Steam achievements are hidden. All 49 API names run ACH_COMPLETEMISSION01 to 49 in list order, so the number is only a sequence; the first 21 hidden ones fall steadily from 86.4% to 31.1%, which looks like one per campaign mission, so they were split into three campaign chapters of seven by that order (a guess; mission names were not in the fetched data). The 22nd hidden one, "ACE OF ACES" (1.5%), does not fit that pattern and was put with campaign mastery next to "Hardened Vet" (1.8%) as a guess. No DLC achievements appear in the Steam list.
